channel.title: StarDev — licensing guides
channel.description: Practical guides on license key systems, HWID, and self-hosted licensing.

item.title: Sistem lisensi untuk APK dan mod APK
item.description: Cara kerja lisensi untuk mod APK dan APK mandiri: HWID dari ANDROID_ID, cache offline, fail-closed, dan contoh panggilan HTTP. Plus opsi source code siap deploy.

item.title: Jasa pembuatan key system — apa yang dikerjakan
item.description: Jasa pasang sistem lisensi: deploy backend, integrasi ke script/APK/bot, uji verifikasi, dan serah terima. Ruang lingkup, estimasi waktu, dan hal yang tidak dikerjakan.

item.title: Alternatif KeyAuth: kapan pindah, kapan tetap
item.description: Kapan layanan key hosted masih masuk akal, kapan pindah ke sistem sendiri lebih murah, dan apa yang harus disiapkan sebelum migrasi.

item.title: License system for Roblox scripts
item.description: How key + HWID verification works for Roblox scripts, what Roblox allows over HTTP, and how to run the licensing backend yourself.

item.title: APK license system that survives real users
item.description: How to license a mod APK or standalone Android app: stable HWID, offline grace period, fail-closed defaults, and an endpoint contract that stays simple.

item.title: Designing a license key API that does not need rewrites
item.description: Design a license key API that stays stable: verify, admin, and HWID endpoints, error shapes, rate limits, and idempotent key creation.

item.title: HWID licensing, without the fantasy
item.description: What a HWID check can and cannot do, how many devices to allow, when to auto-reset, and how to store device identifiers without collecting more than needed.
